content:
maya: quick sync — we need to lock the observability surface for Q3 planning. major asks from sales/enterprise: (1) lightweight dashboards/templates for common workloads, (2) tracing hooks + adaptive sampling for hot paths, (3) per-route / per-model cost breakdown, (4) error analytics with fingerprinting. want tradeoffs + launch criteria by EOD tomorrow :calendar:

sam: +1. can we scope sampling first? tracing + storage cost are the big unknowns.

olivia: for dashboards we can ship 3 templates: 'deploy health', 'cost hotspots', 'error trends' — each pre-filtered by model, route, and region. low frontend effort if we use existing widgets.

leo: storage concern — full traces = expensive. recommend default adaptive sampling: keep 100% for request-level traces when latency > p95 threshold, else 1% for baseline. retention: 7d for full traces, 90d for aggregated metrics.

raj: enterprise asks that cost breakdown shows dedicated vs hosted split and per-route bucketing. also they want a surface to export cost CSV for showback.

maya: proposal for launch criteria (MVP):
- dashboards: 3 templates + saved filter by model/route/time (must support quick pivot)
- traces: hook + header for route id + adaptive sampling rules for hot paths
- cost: per-route daily breakdown, top 10 route list, CSV export
- errors: grouped by fingerprint, trend + alert when spike > 3x baseline
if we hit these we can call GA for beta customers.

sam: implementation detail: trace hook header name suggestion below. will that work for SDKs?
```
# add this header on request start
X-RW-ROUTE-ID: <route-id>
X-RW-TRACE-PROP: app=web,origin=api
```
this keeps routing + sampling deterministic.

olivia: UX note — templates should let users toggle sampling view (raw traces vs aggregated spans). keep the default to aggregated to avoid noise.

leo: cardinality risk: route ids + model variants + customer ids can explode. suggest normalizing route id to a 3-part slug (product, feature, flow) and limit free-form tags. we can surface full tags behind a permission flag.

raj: we should pick 3 pilot customers for canary: Acme, WillowHealth, and FocalOps. they requested early cost export and alerting.

maya: rough effort ask: sam/eng backend 4w, frontend 2w, QA + docs 1w. can we validate? owners: sam (backend), olivia (frontend), leo (infra), raj (customer liaison).

sam: that matches my gut. add 1wk buffer for sampling tuning + retention configs.

olivia: also add an eval: run prompt-set quality checks against live traffic for first 2 weeks to detect quality regressions tied to sampling/quantization changes.

maya: rollout plan: pilot -> 10% orgs -> 50% -> GA. kill/rollback if token cost per-route rises >20% or error rate increases >2x baseline during rollout window.

observability-bot: note created: https://tracking/repo/OBS-4123 — owners assigned, action items added to sprint planning.

maya: action items for tomorrow: final estimates + acceptance tests. I'll compile into a spec doc after standup. reactions: :white_check_mark: :eyes:
